questions.question: A is the sister of B, and B is the father of C. How is A related to C?
questions.explanation: A is the sister of C's father, so A is C's paternal aunt.

questions.question: A's mother's only brother has a son B. B is A's
questions.explanation: The child of one's uncle is a cousin.

questions.question: P is the father of Q, Q is the sister of R, and R is the son of S. How is P related to S?
questions.explanation: P is the father of R and S is the mother of R, so P is S's husband.

questions.question: The husband of my mother's mother is my
questions.explanation: My mother's mother's husband is my maternal grandfather.

questions.question: A is the father of B, B is the mother of C, and D is the sister of A. How is D related to C?
questions.explanation: D is the sister of C's mother's father (the grandfather), so D is a great-aunt.

questions.question: The brother of one's wife is one's
questions.explanation: The wife's brother is the husband's brother-in-law.

questions.question: Pointing to a boy, Ravi says, "He is the son of the only son of my grandfather." The boy is Ravi's
questions.explanation: The only son of Ravi's grandfather is Ravi's father, so the boy is Ravi's brother.

questions.question: If A × B means A is the father of B, A + B means A is the mother of B and A − B means A is the brother of B, then P × Q − R means P is the ___ of R.
questions.explanation: P is the father of Q, and Q is the brother of R, so P is also the father of R.

questions.question: With the same symbols (× father, + mother, − brother), A × B + C means A is the ___ of C.
questions.explanation: A is the father of B and B is the mother of C, so A is C's maternal grandfather.

questions.question: With the same symbols, A − B × C means A is the ___ of C.
questions.explanation: A is the brother of B, and B is the father of C, so A is C's paternal uncle.

questions.question: With the same symbols, A + B − C means A is the ___ of C.
questions.explanation: A is the mother of B, and B is the brother of C, so A is also the mother of C.

questions.question: A and B are a married couple. C is their only son and D is C's wife. How is A (the husband) related to D?
questions.explanation: A is the father of C, D's husband, so A is D's father-in-law.

questions.question: A's mother's only brother has a son B and B has a sister C. How is C related to A?
questions.explanation: B and C are the children of A's maternal uncle, so C is A's cousin.

questions.question: P is the brother of Q, Q is the sister of R, and R is the mother of S. P is S's
questions.explanation: P is the brother of R, S's mother. So P is the maternal uncle.

questions.question: A is the brother of B. B is the father of C. C is the sister of D. D is the son of E. How is A related to E?
questions.explanation: B is D's father and E is D's mother (B's wife). A is B's brother, so A is E's brother-in-law.

questions.question: P is a man. Q is the daughter of P's mother's only son. P is Q's
questions.explanation: P's mother's only son is P himself, so Q is P's daughter.

questions.question: A is a boy. A's mother is the sister of B, and C is B's husband. C is A's
questions.explanation: B is A's maternal aunt, and her husband C is A's uncle.

questions.question: The father of my mother's only brother's son is my
questions.explanation: My mother's only brother's son's father is my mother's only brother, my maternal uncle.

questions.question: Pointing to a man, Anita says, "He is the husband of my mother's only daughter-in-law." The man is Anita's
questions.explanation: Anita's mother's daughter-in-law is Anita's brother's wife, and her husband is Anita's brother.

questions.question: A has two sons B and C. B's wife is D and C's daughter is E. How is D related to E?
questions.explanation: D is the wife of E's father's brother, so D is E's aunt.
